data_description.connection: Pick the hardware that sits between Home Assistant and the spa.

gateway.title: Serial gateway on the network
gateway.description: An adapter such as an Elfin EW11, ser2net or an ESPHome serial server that brings the spa's RS-485 connection onto the network. It has to run in TCP server mode at 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.

wifi_module.title: Balboa Wi-Fi module
wifi_module.description: The original Wi-Fi module made by Balboa (bwa, model 50350).

serial.title: Serial adapter on this machine
serial.description: A USB or GPIO RS-485 adapter wired directly to the spa. Prefer a path under /dev/serial/by-id, which survives a reboot.

discovery_confirm.title: Balboa spa found
discovery_confirm.description: A Balboa Wi-Fi module answered at {host}. Add it?

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Point this spa at a different address. Its entities and history stay as they are.

error.cannot_connect: No connection to that address. Check the IP and port; on an EW11 make sure TCP server mode is switched on.
error.no_data: Connected, but the spa sends nothing. Check the serial settings on the gateway (115200, 8N1) and whether the RS-485 A and B wires are swapped.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This spa is already set up.

data.sync_time: Keep the spa clock in sync

data_description.sync_time: Sets the spa's clock from Home Assistant once an hour.

options.gateway: Serial gateway on the network (EW11, ser2net, ESPHome)
